NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Fidus uses the microphone to hear your requests and to record the meetings you ask it to.
NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Fidus transcribes your speech on your phone to answer faster.
NSCameraUsageDescription: Fidus uses the camera to read receipts.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Fidus accesses your photos to read receipts.
NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Fidus uses Face ID to protect your account.
NSContactsUsageDescription: Fidus uses your contacts only when you choose a contact to pay.
